Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

Let's start with business signup. An owner should be able to register their business, verify their
email, sign in, update their name, change their password, and recover a forgotten password. Each
business has its own users; the same email can belong to different businesses.

Use JSON under `/api/v1`. Signup should look like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/account/create
Content-Type: application/json

{"account":{"name":"Acme","subdomain":"acme","admin":{"name":"Jo","email":"jo@acme.test","password":"my-first-password"}}}
```

Return the new `account` and `user`. Jo is an admin, but needs to verify their email before signing
in. Include record IDs, timestamps, and the user's `role` and `verified` flag.
Use `X-Helpdesk-Account: acme` to choose the business on subsequent requests. Public `GET /portal`
returns its name and subdomain inside `portal`; signed-in users get the full account at `GET /account`.

For login, accept `POST /sessions` with `{"session":{"email":"jo@acme.test","password":"my-first-password"}}`.
Return the user and account alongside `session.token`, which clients send as `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN`.
`DELETE /session` signs out that session. Use `GET /me` and `PATCH /me` for the user's profile, with
changes such as `{"user":{"name":"Jo Smith"}}`. Password changes go to `PUT /me/password` as
`{"password_change":{"current_password":"my-first-password","password":"my-new-password"}}`.

Send verification and password-reset links to the frontend at `HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL`, default
`http://localhost:3001`. Use `/verify-email?account=acme&token=TOKEN` and
`/reset-password?account=acme&token=TOKEN`. The frontend submits the token to
`POST /email_verifications/confirm` as `{"email_verification":{"token":"TOKEN"}}`, or to
`POST /password_resets/confirm` as `{"password_reset":{"token":"TOKEN","password":"my-new-password"}}`.
Users can request another link through `POST /email_verifications` or `POST /password_resets`,
using the same envelopes with an `email` instead. New links replace old ones.
Changing a password should sign out existing sessions.
Allow requests from the configured frontend origin.

Send outgoing email using Action Mailer. Use `HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM` for the sender,
defaulting to `support@example.test`.

Let the owner cancel the account with `POST /account/cancel` and reactivate it with
`POST /account/reactivate` within 90 days. Cancellation revokes sessions and stops ordinary
business access. The owner can still sign in to reactivate the account. Permanently delete
accounts still cancelled after 90 days, including all their data.
Provide `bin/rails helpdesk:purge_cancelled_accounts` for this cleanup.

  belongs_to :owner, class_name: "User", optional: true
  has_many :users, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :sessions, through: :users

  normalizes :subdomain, with: ->(s) { s.to_s.strip.downcase }
  normalizes :name, with: ->(n) { n.to_s.strip }

  validates :name, presence: true

              message: "must be lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens"
            }

  before_destroy :clear_owner_reference, prepend: true

  scope :cancelled, -> { where.not(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :purgeable, -> { where("cancelled_at < ?", CANCELLATION_RETENTION_PERIOD.ago) }

    deleted_count = 0
    purgeable.find_each do |account|

    deleted_count
  end

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?

    !cancelled?

  ROLES = %w[admin agent customer].freeze

  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ROLES }

    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

    return nil if account.nil? || raw_token.blank?

    user = account.users.find_by(email_verification_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
    return nil unless user&.email_verification_sent_at
    return nil if user.email_verification_sent_at < EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY.ago

    user
  end

  def self.find_by_valid_password_reset_token(account, raw_token)
    return nil if account.nil? || raw_token.blank?

    user = account.users.find_by(password_reset_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
    return nil unless user&.password_reset_sent_at
    return nil if user.password_reset_sent_at < PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRY.ago

  end

  def verified?
    verified_at.present?
  end

  def owner_of?(target_account)
    return false unless target_account && target_account.id == account_id

    if target_account.owner_id.present?
      id == target_account.owner_id
    else
      role == "admin"
    end
  end

  def generate_email_verification_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    update!(
      email_verification_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      email_verification_sent_at: Time.current
    )
    raw_token
  end

  def verify_email!
    update!(
      verified_at: Time.current,
      email_verification_token_digest: nil,
      email_verification_sent_at: nil

  def generate_password_reset_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)

      password_reset_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),

require "digest"

class Session < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user

  validates :token_digest, presence: true, uniqueness: true

  def self.digest_token(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.issue_for!(user)
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    session = create!(user: user, token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
    [ session, raw_token ]
  end

  def self.authenticate_for_account(account, raw_token)
    return nil if account.nil? || raw_token.blank?

    joins(:user).find_by(token_digest: digest_token(raw_token), users: { account_id: account.id })
  end

  def as_api_json(raw_token)
    {
      id: id,
      token: raw_token,
      created_at: created_at,
      updated_at: updated_at
    }
  end
end

require "uri"

class FrontendCorsMiddleware
  ALLOWED_METHODS = "GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD".freeze
  ALLOWED_HEADERS = "Authorization, Content-Type, X-Helpdesk-Account, Accept, Origin, X-Requested-With".freeze

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request_origin = env["HTTP_ORIGIN"]
    origin_allowed = origin_allowed?(request_origin)

    if env["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "OPTIONS" && request_origin.present?
      headers = { "Vary" => "Origin" }
      headers.merge!(cors_headers(request_origin)) if origin_allowed
      return [ 204, headers, [] ]
    end

    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    headers = headers.dup

    if request_origin.present?
      append_vary_origin(headers)
      headers.merge!(cors_headers(request_origin)) if origin_allowed
    end

    [ status, headers, body ]
  end

  private

  def origin_allowed?(request_origin)
    return false if request_origin.blank?

    configured = normalize_origin(ENV.fetch("HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL", "http://localhost:3001"))
    incoming = normalize_origin(request_origin)
    configured.present? && incoming == configured
  end

  def normalize_origin(url)
    uri = URI.parse(url.to_s.strip)
    return nil unless uri.scheme.present? && uri.host.present?

    scheme = uri.scheme.downcase
    host = uri.host.downcase
    default_port = (scheme == "https" ? 443 : 80)
    port = uri.port
    port && port != default_port ? "#{scheme}://#{host}:#{port}" : "#{scheme}://#{host}"
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    nil
  end

  def cors_headers(origin)
    {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" => origin,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" => ALLOWED_METHODS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => ALLOWED_HEADERS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials" => "true",
      "Access-Control-Max-Age" => "86400"
    }
  end

  def append_vary_origin(headers)
    existing = headers["Vary"]
    if existing.blank?
      headers["Vary"] = "Origin"
    elsif !existing.split(",").map(&:strip).include?("Origin")
      headers["Vary"] = "#{existing}, Origin"
    end
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing, with: :render_parameter_missing
      rescue_from ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError, with: :render_invalid_json
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid, with: :render_record_invalid

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render json: { error: "X-Helpdesk-Account header is required" }, status: :bad_request
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        return if @current_account.nil?

        if @current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_session!
        raw_token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate_for_account(current_account, raw_token)
        if @current_session.nil?
          return render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_owner!
        return if current_user&.owner_of?(current_account)

        render json: { error: "Only the account owner can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        auth_header = request.authorization.to_s
        match = auth_header.match(/\ABearer\s+(\S+)\z/i)
        match && match[1]
      end

      def render_parameter_missing(exception)
        render json: { error: exception.message }, status: :bad_request
      end

      def render_invalid_json(_exception)
        render json: { error: "Invalid JSON payload" }, status: :bad_request
      end

      def render_record_invalid(exception)
        record = exception.record
        render json: {
          error: record.errors.full_messages.to_sentence,
          errors: record.errors.to_hash(true)
        }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

module Api
  module V1
    class AccountsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!, only: [ :show, :cancel, :reactivate ]
      before_action :require_session!, only: [ :show, :cancel, :reactivate ]
      before_action :require_active_account!, only: [ :show, :cancel ]
      before_action :require_owner!, only: [ :cancel, :reactivate ]

      def create
        account_attrs = params.require(:account)
        admin_attrs = account_attrs.require(:admin).permit(:name, :email, :password)

        account = Account.new(account_attrs.permit(:name, :subdomain))
        user = account.users.build(admin_attrs.merge(role: "admin"))
        raw_token = nil

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          account.save!
          user.save!
          account.update!(owner_id: user.id)
          raw_token = user.generate_email_verification_token!
        end

        UserMailer.email_verification(user, raw_token).deliver_now

        render json: {
          account: account.as_api_json,
          user: user.as_api_json
        }, status: :created
      end

      def show
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def cancel
        current_account.cancel!
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def reactivate
        unless current_account.cancelled?
          return render json: { error: "Account is not cancelled" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        if current_account.cancellation_expired?
          return render json: { error: "Account reactivation period has expired" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        current_account.reactivate!
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

module Api
  module V1
    class SessionsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!
      before_action :require_session!, only: [ :destroy ]

      def create
        session_params = params.require(:session).permit(:email, :password)
        email = session_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase
        password = session_params[:password].to_s

        user = current_account.users.find_by(email: email)
        unless user&.authenticate(password)
          return render json: { error: "Invalid email or password" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        unless user.verified?
          return render json: { error: "Email must be verified before signing in" }, status: :forbidden
        end

        if current_account.cancelled?
          if current_account.cancellation_expired?
            return render json: { error: "Account cancellation period has expired" }, status: :forbidden
          end

          unless user.owner_of?(current_account)
            return render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
          end
        end

        session, raw_token = Session.issue_for!(user)

        render json: {
          session: session.as_api_json(raw_token),
          user: user.as_api_json,
          account: current_account.as_api_json
        }, status: :created
      end

      def destroy
        current_session.destroy!
        render json: { message: "Signed out" }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end

  test "owner can cancel and reactivate within 90 days; cancellation revokes sessions and stops ordinary access" do

    agent_token = sign_in(subdomain: "acme", email: "agent@acme.test", password: "agent-password").dig("session", "token")

    # Non-owner cannot cancel
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel",
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{agent_token}" }
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Owner cancels
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel",
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{owner_token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_nil json_response.dig("account", "cancelled_at")

    # Existing sessions are revoked
    get "/api/v1/me", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{owner_token}" }
    assert_response :unauthorized
    get "/api/v1/me", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{agent_token}" }
    assert_response :unauthorized

    # Portal is unavailable while cancelled
    get "/api/v1/portal", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" }
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Non-owner cannot sign in while cancelled
    post "/api/v1/sessions",
         params: { session: { email: "agent@acme.test", password: "agent-password" } },
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
         as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Owner CAN sign in to reactivate
    new_owner_token = sign_in(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "my-first-password").dig("session", "token")

    # Ordinary business access is still blocked while cancelled
    get "/api/v1/account", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" }
    assert_response :forbidden
    get "/api/v1/me", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" }
    assert_response :forbidden
    patch "/api/v1/me",
          params: { user: { name: "Blocked" } },
          headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" },
          as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Owner reactivates within 90 days
    post "/api/v1/account/reactivate",
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_nil json_response.dig("account", "cancelled_at")

    # Access restored
    get "/api/v1/portal", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" }
    assert_response :success
    get "/api/v1/account", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" }
    assert_response :success
    sign_in(subdomain: "acme", email: "agent@acme.test", password: "agent-password")
  end

  test "cannot reactivate after 90 days and purge task permanently deletes expired cancelled accounts" do
    expired_data = create_and_verify_account(name: "Expired", subdomain: "expired", email: "jo@expired.test")
    recent_data = create_and_verify_account(name: "Recent", subdomain: "recent", email: "jo@recent.test")
    active_data = create_and_verify_account(name: "Active", subdomain: "active", email: "jo@active.test")

    post "/api/v1/sessions",

         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "expired" },

    # Non-owner cannot cancel
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel",
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{agent_token}" }
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Owner cancels
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel",
         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{owner_token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_nil json_response.dig("account", "cancelled_at")

    assert_response :unauthorized
    get "/api/v1/me", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{agent_token}" }
    assert_response :unauthorized

    # Portal and verification/reset are unavailable while cancelled

    assert_response :forbidden

    post "/api/v1/password_resets",

         headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },

    new_owner_token = sign_in(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "my-first-password").dig("session", "token")

    get "/api/v1/account", headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{new_owner_token}" }

module Api
  module V1
    class AccountsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!, only: [ :show, :cancel, :reactivate ]
      before_action :require_session!, only: [ :show, :cancel, :reactivate ]
      before_action :require_active_account!, only: [ :show, :cancel ]
      before_action :require_owner!, only: [ :cancel, :reactivate ]

      def create
        account_attrs = params.require(:account)
        account_attrs.require(:admin)
        permitted = account_attrs.permit(:name, :subdomain, admin: [ :name, :email, :password ])
        admin_attrs = permitted.delete(:admin)

        account = Account.new(permitted)
        user = account.users.build(admin_attrs.merge(role: "admin"))
        raw_token = nil

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          account.save!
          user.save!
          account.update!(owner_id: user.id)
          raw_token = user.generate_email_verification_token!
        end

        UserMailer.email_verification(user, raw_token).deliver_now

        render json: {
          account: account.as_api_json,
          user: user.as_api_json
        }, status: :created
      end

      def show
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def cancel
        current_account.cancel!
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def reactivate
        unless current_account.cancelled?
          return render json: { error: "Account is not cancelled" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        if current_account.cancellation_expired?
          return render json: { error: "Account reactivation period has expired" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        current_account.reactivate!
        render json: { account: current_account.as_api_json }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end
